verdict.rationale: The evidence shows AI building blocks: VectorsDB for embeddings, image-labeling capabilities for AI-powered apps built on Functions, and an MCP server that lets external agents operate on a project. None of it documents in-product AI-generated insights or suggestions about the user's own data, so these are adjacent developer primitives or external-agent tooling and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
